image.label: Nano Banana (Gemini 2.5 Flash Image)
image.notes: Ref image count limit not stated in schema ('supports multiple images').

image.label: Nano Banana 2 (Gemini 3.1 Flash Image)
image.notes: Also google_search / image_search booleans (default false).

image.label: Nano Banana 2.1
image.notes: Same schema as nano-banana-2 (google_search / image_search booleans).

image.label: Nano Banana Pro
image.notes: Also safety_filter_level (default block_only_high) and allow_fallback_model (bool, default false; falls back to bytedance/seedream-5).

image.label: Imagen 4
image.notes: Text-only. Resolution field is image_size. safety_filter_level default block_only_high.

image.label: Imagen 4 Fast
image.notes: Text-only, no resolution option.

image.label: Imagen 4 Ultra
image.notes: Text-only. Resolution field is image_size.

image.label: FLUX.1 [schnell]
image.notes: Output is a LIST. megapixels enum strings '1'/'0.25'. num_outputs 1-4, num_inference_steps 1-4 (default 4).

image.label: FLUX.1 [dev]
image.notes: Output is a LIST. 'image' is a single img2img init image (string, not list); prompt_strength 0-1 default 0.8. Output aspect follows input image when given.

image.label: FLUX 1.1 [pro]
image.notes: image_prompt is a Redux composition guide (single string), not a true edit. aspect 'custom' needs width/height (256-1440, multiple of 32). safety_tolerance 1-6.

image.label: FLUX 1.1 [pro] Ultra
image.notes: image_prompt (single string) with image_prompt_strength 0-1 default 0.1. raw bool. safety_tolerance 1-6.

image.label: FLUX.1 Kontext [pro]
image.notes: Single input_image (string). Works text-only too. safety_tolerance 0-6 (max 2 with input image).

image.label: FLUX.1 Kontext [max]
image.notes: Single input_image (string). safety_tolerance 0-6 (max 2 with input image).

image.label: FLUX.2 [pro]
image.notes: Field is input_images (plural). aspect 'custom' needs width/height 256-2048 (multiple of 16). safety_tolerance 1-5.

image.label: FLUX.2 [max]
image.notes: Field is input_images. safety_tolerance 1-5.

image.label: FLUX.2 [flex]
image.notes: Field is input_images. steps 1-50 (30), guidance 1.5-10 (4.5), prompt_upsampling default true.

image.label: FLUX.2 [dev]
image.notes: Field is input_images, max 5. No resolution enum; 'custom' aspect uses width/height 256-1440.

image.label: FLUX 3 Image
image.notes: Field is 'images'. grounding (web search) default true. safety_tolerance 0-4. Resolution values lowercase ('1k').

image.label: Seedream 4
image.notes: Output is a LIST. Resolution field is 'size' ('custom' -> width/height 1024-4096). No output_format field. sequential_image_generation default 'disabled'.

image.label: Seedream 4.5
image.notes: Output is a LIST. 'size' has no 1K. No output_format field.

image.label: Seedream 5.0 Lite
image.notes: Output is a LIST. size 2K/3K. output_format png/jpeg.

image.label: Qwen Image
image.notes: Output is a LIST. 'image' is img2img init (single string) with strength 0-1 default 0.9. image_size enum optimize_for_quality/optimize_for_speed (not a resolution). Supports LoRA.

image.label: Qwen Image Edit
image.notes: Output is a LIST. 'image' is REQUIRED (single string).

image.label: Qwen Image Edit Plus
image.notes: Output is a LIST. 'image' is a REQUIRED ARRAY of URIs (max not stated).

image.label: Ideogram 3.0 Turbo
image.notes: style_reference_images are style refs only (list), not edit inputs. 'image'+'mask' = inpainting. 'resolution' enum of ~70 WxH strings (default 'None') overrides aspect_ratio — omitted here. style_type, style_preset, magic_prompt_option (Auto/On/Off). No output_format.

image.label: Recraft V3
image.notes: Text-only. aspect_ratio default 'Not set'; 'size' (WxH enum) is ignored if aspect set. 'style' enum (default 'any'). No output_format.

image.label: GPT Image 1.5
image.notes: Output is a LIST. openai_api_key optional (proxy used if omitted). quality low/medium/high/auto, background auto/transparent/opaque, input_fidelity low/high, moderation auto/low. (openai/gpt-image-1 REQUIRES openai_api_key, so excluded.)

image.label: GPT Image 2
image.notes: Output is a LIST. aspect_ratio enum mixes ratios, 'auto' and WxH sizes up to 3840x2160 (>2560x1440 experimental). openai_api_key optional.

image.label: Grok Imagine Image 2.0
image.notes: Single 'image' for editing; aspect_ratio ignored when editing. quality low/medium (default medium). No output_format.

image.label: Wan 2.7 Image Pro
image.notes: Output is a LIST. No aspect field — aspect is encoded in 'size' (e.g. '1280*720', uses '*'); '1K/2K/4K' auto-size, 4K only for text-to-image. thinking_mode default true.

video.label: Kling v2.1
video.notes: start_image REQUIRED (image-to-video only). 'mode' standard=720p / pro=1080p. end_image requires pro mode. No aspect field.

video.label: Kling v2.1 Master
video.notes: aspect_ratio ignored if start_image given. No resolution option.

video.label: Kling 2.5 Turbo Pro
video.notes: end_image supported. 'image' field is deprecated alias of start_image. aspect_ratio ignored with start_image.

video.label: Kling v2.6
video.notes: generate_audio default TRUE. aspect_ratio ignored with start_image. No end_image.

video.label: Kling Video 3.0
video.notes: duration integer range 3-15. mode standard(720p)/pro(1080p)/4k. end_image requires start_image. generate_audio default false. multi_prompt JSON string for multi-shot.

video.label: Veo 3
video.notes: generate_audio default true. negative_prompt, seed.

video.label: Veo 3 Fast
video.notes: generate_audio default true.

video.label: Veo 3.1
video.notes: last_frame (end frame). reference_images 1-3 (only 16:9 + 8s). generate_audio default true.

video.label: Veo 3.1 Fast
video.notes: last_frame supported. generate_audio default true.

video.label: Veo 3.1 Lite
video.notes: last_frame supported. Duration must be 8 at 1080p. No generate_audio field.

video.label: Sora 2
video.notes: Duration field is 'seconds'. aspect_ratio is 'portrait'/'landscape' (720x1280 / 1280x720); input_reference image must match that aspect. openai_api_key optional.

video.label: Sora 2 Pro
video.notes: Duration field 'seconds'. resolution standard(720p)/high(1024p). input_reference must match aspect.

video.label: Seedance 1 Lite
video.notes: duration integer range 4-12. last_frame_image, reference_images (1-4). aspect ignored with image. fps fixed 24.

video.label: Seedance 1 Pro
video.notes: duration integer range 2-12. last_frame_image. aspect ignored with image.

video.label: Seedance 1 Pro Fast
video.notes: duration integer range 2-12. No last frame.

video.label: Seedance 1.5 Pro
video.notes: duration 2-12. generate_audio default true. last_frame_image.

video.label: Seedance 2.0
video.notes: duration integer -1..15 (-1 = model picks). Resolution includes 4k. aspect 'adaptive'. image cannot be combined with reference_images. generate_audio default true.

video.label: Seedance 2.0 Fast
video.notes: duration -1..15. Resolution 480p/720p only.

video.label: Hailuo 02
video.notes: No aspect field (follows first frame). 10s only at 768p. last_frame_image supported. prompt_optimizer default true.

video.label: Hailuo 2.3
video.notes: 10s only at 768p; 1080p = 6s only. No aspect field.

video.label: Hailuo 2.3 Fast
video.notes: first_frame_image REQUIRED. 1080p = 6s only.

video.label: Wan 2.2 I2V Fast
video.notes: image REQUIRED. NO duration field: length = num_frames (81-121, default 81) / frames_per_second (5-30, default 16) => ~5s default. last_image supported. LoRA support.

video.label: Wan 2.5 I2V
video.notes: image REQUIRED. Optional audio (wav/mp3) for sync. No aspect field.

video.label: Wan 2.6 I2V
video.notes: image REQUIRED. multi_shots bool. Optional audio.

video.label: Wan 2.7 I2V
video.notes: Start field is 'first_frame'; last_frame supported; prompt optional (default ''). duration 2-15. Audio auto-generated if none given.

video.label: Wan 3.0
video.notes: duration integer 2-30. aspect 'adaptive' default; ignored with image.

video.label: Luma Ray 2 (720p)
video.notes: end_image, loop, concepts (camera list). start_image_url deprecated. Also luma/ray-2-540p exists (luma/ray-2 is NOT a model).

video.label: Luma Ray 3.2
video.notes: start_image only valid with 5s duration. hdr / exr_export / loop options.

video.label: PixVerse v5
video.notes: Resolution field is 'quality'. last_frame_image. effect enum.

video.label: PixVerse V6
video.notes: Resolution field 'quality'. aspect ignored with image. generate_audio_switch default false.

video.label: Runway Gen-4 Turbo
video.notes: image REQUIRED (image-to-video only).

video.label: Runway Gen-4.5
video.notes: image optional.

video.label: Grok Imagine Video 1.5
video.notes: image REQUIRED. duration integer 1-15. aspect 'auto' default.

video.label: Vidu Q3 Pro
video.notes: duration integer 1-16. end_image supported. 'audio' is a BOOLEAN (default true). aspect ignored with images.

video.label: LTX 2.5 Fast
video.notes: >10s only at 720p/1080p with 24/25 fps. fps enum 24/25/48/50. last_frame_image. generate_audio default true.

video.label: FLUX 3 (video)
video.notes: Starting image goes in 'images' ARRAY (1 image = first frame, 2 = first+last). Duration is a STRING enum incl. 'auto'. start_video for continuation. safety_tolerance 0-4 (max 2 with inputs).

video.label: HappyHorse 1.1
video.notes: Starting image goes in 'images' ARRAY (1 image = first frame; multiple up to 9 = reference-to-video). prompt optional for single-image i2v. aspect ignored for single-image i2v.
